2607.19201.title: MIRA-Ev:A Benchmark for Granular Evidence Detection and Relational Reasoning in Clinical Exams
2607.19201.paper_summary: Clinical NLP evaluation remains dominated by multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), which scores only final-answer accuracy and cannot detect when a model reaches the correct diagnosis while grounding it in irrelevant, absent, or contradictory evidence. We introduce MIRA-Ev, a clinical argument mining benchmark built on Spanish Médico Interno Residente (MIR) licensing-exam cases, re-annotated by expert clinicians with span-level premises, claims, and directed support/attack relations, and released in parallel Spanish (native), English, and Basque versions, the first clinical argumentation resource in Basque. MIRA-Ev organizes evaluation into a three-tier task hierarchy: evidence sentence retrieval, argumentative component extraction, and relation classification.
2607.19201.paper_summary_zh: 臨床自然語言處理評估仍然以多選題回答（MCQA）為主，這僅評估最終答案的準確性，無法檢測模型在不相關、缺失或矛盾的證據中達到正確診斷的情況。我們介紹了 MIRA-Ev，一個基於西班牙醫生實習生（MIR）執照考試案例的臨床論證挖掘基準，經專家臨床醫生重新標註，包含範圍級的前提、主張和指向性的支持/攻擊關係，並以西班牙語（母語）、英語和巴斯克語的平行版本發布，這是巴斯克語的第一個臨床論證資源。MIRA-Ev 將評估組織為三層任務層級：證據句檢索、論證組件提取和關係分類。
